verdict.rationale: Requiring SAML single sign-on is a fair security axis for a SaaS code-hosting platform like Bitbucket, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions SAML, SSO, or identity-provider enforcement. The only authentication controls documented are 2FA and IP allowlisting, which are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can require SAML single sign-on for my organization
